## Description

The array of all tank heroes in Overwatch. The order is currently as follows:
        
        0. Reinhardt
        1. Winston
        2. Roadhog
        3. Zarya
        4. D.Va
				5. Doomfist
        6. Orisa
        7. Wrecking Ball
        8. Junker Queen
				9. Sigma
				10. Ramattra
				11. Mauga
				12. Hazard
				13. Domina
        
 Note that the order may change as new heroes get added.
